{{Top|leg}}
'''Nalvar grass''' was a thick-leaved plant growing in the harsh [[Nalvar]] region of the planet [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]]. The native [[Svivreni]] sometimes used Nalvar grass leaves to braid their long manes, as a homage to their planet.
